gui.packcore.wizard.page.main_menu_desig: Choose a style for your main menu.
Choose how your main menu looks. If you use mods that add buttons to the main menu, choose the Vanilla option. Otherwise, Modern is recommended as it gives the game a SkyBlock feel.
Disables all shaders and reduces visual quality to squeeze out the most frames possible.
gui.packcore.wizard.performance.balanced: A middle ground between performance and visuals. Good for most systems.
Prioritises visual quality over frame rate. Recommended for higher-end hardware.
gui.packcore.wizard.performance.quality_: Quality settings with lightweight shaders that add visual polish without a heavy FPS cost.
Full quality settings with demanding shaders. Requires a capable GPU.
gui.packcore.wizard.page.tab_design.subt: Choose how your tab list looks.
gui.packcore.wizard.page.tab_design.expl: Choose a tab list style. Compact comes from SkyHanni and shows more information in a condensed layout. Fancy comes from Skyblocker and uses a more decorative, styled display.
gui.packcore.wizard.tab_design.compact.d: A condensed tab list from SkyHanni.
gui.packcore.wizard.tab_design.fancy.des: A decorative styled tab list from Skyblocker.
gui.packcore.wizard.page.item_background: Choose a background style for items.
Choose how items appear in your inventory. All options come from Skyblocker. None uses the default Minecraft look, while Circle and Square add a styled background behind each item slot.
gui.packcore.wizard.item_background.none: Default Minecraft item appearance with no background.
gui.packcore.wizard.item_background.circ: A circular background behind each item from Skyblocker.
gui.packcore.wizard.item_background.squa: A square background behind each item from Skyblocker.
Choose how your SkyBlock storage is displayed. Overlay shows a full storage GUI with all pages visible at once. Vanilla keeps the default chest look but adds tooltips showing what each page contains when you hover over it.
gui.packcore.wizard.storage_design.overl: A full storage overlay showing all pages and their contents at once.
gui.packcore.wizard.storage_design.vanil: Default chest appearance with tooltips showing each page's contents on hover.
